records.text: LinkedIn and ZoomInfo remnants identified a Tucson-area Thomas Martin as a U.S. Border Patrol director and former Deputy Chief Patrol Agent at the Department of Homeland Security.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I'm going to show you what's left of the LinkedIn link. ... You can't actually click it. You can see it says Thomas Martin, ... director, ... U.S. Border Patrol, ... location, ... greater Tucson area. ... looking at Zoom Info, we were again able to find this sort of relic. We found that he was Deputy Chief Patrol Agent at the Department of Homeland Security.

verification.notes: The episode shows search-result remnants attributed to LinkedIn and ZoomInfo. Those exact profiles were not independently recoverable, but an official DHS roster corroborates a Thomas Martin serving in Tucson-sector border operations and as an Arizona Counter-Terrorism Task Force deputy chief of staff. It does not establish that this is the same individual as the 1985 agent or support the extracted U.S. Southern Command framing.

records.text: A House budget bill listed Intellimet Laboratories as receiving money from the Department of Homeland Security in 2005.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But the most crucial part of 2005 is what Lori Frantzve is doing. Because people have pointed this out, but there is a relic that shows you that she received money from the government. ... Intellimet Laboratories. ... She's listed in the House bill budget. She's receiving money from the Department of Homeland Security.

verification.notes: A DHS FOIA log confirms a 2005 request concerning iMet Laboratories, Lori Frantzve, and House Bill HD2360, but it does not establish that the organization received DHS funds. The extracted name also conflates iMet Laboratories with Intellimet. No appropriation or award record supporting the exact claim was located.

records.text: Jeremy Boreing's ultimate goal in encouraging reporters to investigate George Farmer was to have Farmer's citizenship revoked.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Where did this go? Reporters should try to find out what happened here. The ultimate goal is he wants George (George Farmer)'s citizenship to be revoked.

records.text: Candace Owens and George Farmer did not pay anyone off or willfully lie to the Department of Homeland Security about a DUI conviction.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And to be clear, wrongly, of course, that there is now a Hail Mary chance that George (George Farmer) and I broke federal law by hiding and willfully lying to the Department of Homeland Security about a DUI conviction. It is utterly untrue. We would have never taken that risk with children and they will come up dry. So reporters feel free to look into that. We absolutely would have never lied. Laura (Laura Loomer) is tagging people.

verification.notes: This is a categorical negative claim that Owens and Farmer neither paid anyone nor lied to Homeland Security. Current public allegations and secondary reporting do not provide access to private payments or protected immigration records sufficient to prove the negative.
